item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:50 HKT 16/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be mainly fine over the coast of Guangdong today. It will be warm during the day. The northeast monsoon affecting southern China is expected to strengthen in the next couple of days. It will be windy over the coastal areas. Under the persistent influence of the monsoon, it will be cool in the morning and at night and cloudier over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week.
